# Merge Two 2D Arrays by Summing Values.

@example Product 3 sold at both checkouts, 10 + 4 units; each other product at one checkout only.
[[3,10],[8,1]]
[[2,5],[3,4],[9,7]]
=> [[2,5],[3,14],[8,1],[9,7]]

@example Both tallies list the same products, so every row adds two values.
[[4,6],[7,9],[12,1]]
[[4,2],[7,9],[12,30]]
=> [[4,8],[7,18],[12,31]]

@example No product is shared, and the one in nums2 has the smallest number, so its row comes first.
[[50,3],[60,2]]
[[5,11]]
=> [[5,11],[50,3],[60,2]]

# One row each, the same product.
[[1,1]]
[[1,1]]
=> [[1,2]]

# One row each, different products: the smaller number comes first,
# whichever tally it is in. Ids 1 and 1000, the ends of the range.
[[1000,7]]
[[1,500]]
=> [[1,500],[1000,7]]

# A total of 256 overflows an unsigned char.
[[5,128]]
[[5,128]]
=> [[5,256]]

# The largest total, 2000, at id 1000.
[[999,1000],[1000,1000]]
[[1000,1000]]
=> [[999,1000],[1000,2000]]

# nums1 runs out first, and several rows of nums2 are left.
[[2,1],[4,1]]
[[1,3],[3,3],[5,3],[6,3],[7,3]]
=> [[1,3],[2,1],[3,3],[4,1],[5,3],[6,3],[7,3]]

# nums2 runs out first, and several rows of nums1 are left.
[[1,5],[6,5],[7,5],[8,5]]
[[1,2],[3,2]]
=> [[1,7],[3,2],[6,5],[7,5],[8,5]]

# The ids alternate between the tallies.
[[1,9],[3,8],[5,7]]
[[2,6],[4,5],[6,4]]
=> [[1,9],[2,6],[3,8],[4,5],[5,7],[6,4]]

# Shared ids only at the first and the last row.
[[10,1],[20,2],[30,3]]
[[10,4],[25,5],[30,6]]
=> [[10,5],[20,2],[25,5],[30,9]]

# All of nums1 comes before nums2. Equal values for different products
# stay separate rows.
[[1,5],[2,5]]
[[3,5],[4,5]]
=> [[1,5],[2,5],[3,5],[4,5]]

# One row against seven, shared in the middle.
[[500,7]]
[[100,1],[200,1],[300,1],[400,1],[500,1],[600,1],[700,1]]
=> [[100,1],[200,1],[300,1],[400,1],[500,8],[600,1],[700,1]]



# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
[[1,7],[6,8],[7,6],[8,4]]
[[1,3],[7,9]]
=> [[1,10],[6,8],[7,15],[8,4]]

@gen 2 small
[[995,9],[999,2]]
[[996,3]]
=> [[995,9],[996,3],[999,2]]

@gen 3 small
[[998,5]]
[[993,1]]
=> [[993,1],[998,5]]

@gen 4 small
[[4,6],[5,8],[7,5],[8,2]]
[[2,8],[4,2],[7,5]]
=> [[2,8],[4,8],[5,8],[7,10],[8,2]]

@gen 5 small
[[1,4],[2,3],[6,5],[7,4],[8,8]]
[[1,2],[7,9]]
=> [[1,6],[2,3],[6,5],[7,13],[8,8]]

@gen 6 small
[[4,7],[6,3]]
[[3,1],[4,5],[5,9],[6,7],[7,5]]
=> [[3,1],[4,12],[5,9],[6,10],[7,5]]
